Messages.Author: Johan Lundstrom
Messages.Body:
Hi!

This is my first posting here, and I'd like to ask about some rules
Q's that has come up in recent games here.

1. If one player plays Catatonic Fear and the other plays another S:CE
card, does player two take damage?

2. DotB+Catatonic Fear. Aggravated or not?

3. Another player just played Mind Rape on one of my vampires. Can I
now (before the actual take-over) play Secure Haven on my vampire to
protect him from the effect, as "the vampire cannot be affected by D
actions?

4. Player A has Malkavian Madness Network out. If he plays Reversal of
Fortune after his turn, who goes next? What if he plays Dramatic
Upheaval to change places with his prey?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Johan Lundstrom wrote:
> This is my first posting here, and I'd like to ask about some rules
> Q's that has come up in recent games here.
>
> 1. If one player plays Catatonic Fear and the other plays another S:CE
> card, does player two take damage?

Yes. Catatonic Fear's damage is applied after combat ends (by errata).

> 2. DotB+Catatonic Fear. Aggravated or not?

Not.
(The same answer applies for Dawn Operation + Catatonic Fear).

> 3. Another player just played Mind Rape on one of my vampires. Can I
> now (before the actual take-over) play Secure Haven on my vampire to
> protect him from the effect, as "the vampire cannot be affected by D
> actions?

No. The (D) action is over. The effect is to put the card on the vampire.
While a new Mind Rape card could not be put on the vampire (as that would
be the effect of a (D) action), the existing Mind Rape card on the Secured
vampire can and will be burned during the appropriate minion phase).

Mind Rape
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Dominate
(D) Bleed with +2 bleed. (S) (D) Put this card on a younger vampire {and tap
that vampire. The vampire with this card does not untap as normal during his
controller's untap phase. During the acting vampire's controller's next
minion phase, he or she must burn this card to untap the vampire and take
control of the vampire until the end of his or her turn}.

> 4. Player A has Malkavian Madness Network out. If he plays Reversal of
> Fortune after his turn, who goes next?

The player to the right of the players whose turn it is (assuming it is
the first Reversal successfully called).

> What if he plays Dramatic Upheaval to change places with his prey?

They change positions. Then the player whose turn it is finishes her
turn. Then the turn proceeds to the left as normal (unless a Reversal
of Fortunes has changed that).
